newsitem.title: UK: UK Energy Grp H1 pretax profits 260 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: UK Energy Grp H1 pretax profits 260 mln stg.

text.p: Britain's Energy Group reported proforma pretax profits of 260 million pounds ($423.7 million) on Friday for the six-month period to March 1997 after announcing an agreed $9.6 billion takeover offer from PacifiCorp, a diversified energy company in the U.S. and Australia.
Energy said it had recommended an interim dividend of 5.5 pence a share, payable on July 4 as its underlying operating profit rose 30 percent to 317 million pounds.

Earlier on Friday, PacifiCorp said it was paying 6.955 pounds or $11.33 per share and will assume the British company's $3.8 billion debt. The U.S. company will also sell its Pacific Telecom unit for $1.5 billion.
Both companies unanimously approved the transaction which now awaits regulatory approvals in the UK and U.S.
Energy Group's proforma group turnover rose 38 percent to 2.52 billion pounds from 1.83 billion, out of which 1.80 billion came from its power units.

Another 647 million pounds came from coal as its U.S.-based Peabody led the U.S. coal industry with a 15 percent market share. The company's turnover from its networks business was slightly down at 274 million pounds from 278 million in the previous year.
The company's share price was marginally ahead by three pence to 651 at 1130 GMT.
